subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about completed applications for {Brand}. Since Appcast's 2025 benchmark landed, with cost-per-hire at $851 and cost-per-application rising on job-board and programmatic pricing shifts, recruitment CPCs now run between $0.30 and $2.50 by role and competition. That is exactly the spread where optimizing to the validated submit decides your real cost. We hold out a control group, so paid completed applications read as incremental to the seekers a marketplace like LinkedIn would have captured organically. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: Appcast 2025 benchmark shift (sourced) + recruitment CPC band $0.30-$2.50
register_notes: Stage 2 EN jobs_recruitment Nigeria: acknowledges 2nd follow-up + references prior; fresh angle = timely sourced development (Appcast 2025 benchmark, CPH $851, CPA rising) + verified recruitment CPC band $0.30-$2.50 (pin.com); rotated peer LinkedIn from brand_candidates as quality bar; MobUpps holdout/incrementality referenced with no figure; market numbers web-verified with URLs; exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no X-not-Y; native register.
